offers.title: 5% cashback on eligible online spends
offers.terms: 5% cashback on eligible online spends and 1% on eligible offline POS spends. Effective 1 Apr 2026, maximum per statement cycle is ₹2,000 online plus ₹2,000 offline (₹4,000 total). Excludes fuel, rent, wallet, utility, insurance, education, jewellery, railways, merchant EMI/Flexipay EMI, digital gaming, tolls, government transactions and other excluded MCCs.

offers.title: 10 reward points per ₹100 on eligible PhonePe spends
offers.terms: Earn 10 Reward Points/₹100 on eligible PhonePe spends, 5 points/₹100 on eligible online spends and 1 point/₹100 on other spends. SBI states 1 point = ₹1. Includes 4 domestic lounge visits/year (maximum 1/quarter), Priority Pass membership for first two years, ₹5,000 Yatra voucher at ₹5 lakh annual spends, annual fee reversal at ₹3 lakh previous membership-year spends, and 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions ₹500–₹4,000 (max ₹250/statement cycle). Welcome gift: PhonePe e-gift card worth ₹1,500, subject to welcome T&Cs.

offers.title: Flat ₹120 off Swiggy food delivery
offers.terms: Axis product page lists flat ₹120 off on Swiggy food delivery. Confirm minimum order, applicable promo flow and frequency in current card T&Cs before paying.

offers.title: Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket via District
offers.terms: 100% discount on the second movie ticket via District, subject to card variant terms. From 1 Nov 2026, eligibility requires ₹25,000 spends in the preceding 3 months; newly issued cards receive an initial eligibility waiver as per issuer T&Cs.

offers.title: Cleartrip flight and hotel discounts
offers.terms: 7% off flights up to ₹2,000 and 18% off hotels up to ₹4,000. Axis product page lists each benefit once per use per month; check current booking T&Cs.

offers.title: Complimentary SonyLIV Premium annual subscription
offers.terms: Axis lists a complimentary SonyLIV Premium annual subscription valued at ₹1,499. Product page specifies first-year benefit; activation and eligibility conditions apply.

offers.title: Flat ₹120 off Zomato
offers.terms: Axis lists flat ₹120 off Zomato, twice a month. Minimum order, promo code, maximum discount and eligibility are governed by live offer T&Cs.

offers.title: 10% off Blinkit
offers.terms: Axis lists 10% off Blinkit on Neo. Confirm current minimum spend, maximum discount, eligible items and monthly usage limit in checkout T&Cs.

offers.title: 10% off BookMyShow
offers.terms: Axis lists 10% off BookMyShow on Neo. Confirm current minimum transaction, cap and usage limit in checkout T&Cs.

offers.title: ₹150 off Zomato on Saturdays
offers.terms: Spend above ₹600; ₹150 maximum discount; once per month per user; Saturdays only. Promo code AMEXNETWORK. Applicable to Axis Privilege on American Express network.

offers.title: ₹150 off Blinkit on Saturdays
offers.terms: Transactions above ₹1,500; ₹150 instant discount; once per user per month; Saturdays only. Promo code AMEXWEEKEND. Excludes milk, tobacco, cigarettes and baby needs.

offers.title: ₹150 off Swiggy food orders
offers.terms: Spend ₹600 and get ₹150 instant discount; Saturdays only, once during the offer period. Promo code AMEX150. Confirm eligible cart and payment terms at checkout.

offers.title: Up to 5% Amazon cashback
offers.terms: Amazon Prime members earn 5% on eligible Amazon.in purchases; non-Prime members earn 3% on eligible products. Digital products and gift cards earn 2%. Earn 2% on eligible Amazon Pay partner merchants and 1% on other eligible spends. No joining/annual fee; rewards credited as Amazon Pay balance. Fuel, rent, tax, education, utilities, EMI and other specified categories are excluded from rewards; 1% fuel surcharge waiver applies separately.

offers.title: Up to ₹500 monthly BookMyShow benefit
offers.terms: Spend ₹5,000 in a billing month to unlock two movie/stream/play/event/sports/activity tickets up to ₹250 each. Both tickets must be booked in one transaction. Offer valid for one billing period; specified MCCs do not count toward qualifying spend.

offers.title: Up to ₹100 food and beverage discount
offers.terms: Book movie tickets on BookMyShow using RBL Play and get up to ₹100 off eligible food and beverage items, subject to platform and card terms.

offers.title: Fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹100/month
offers.terms: Fuel transactions between ₹500 and ₹4,000 qualify for a surcharge waiver up to ₹100 per month, subject to issuer terms.

offers.title: Up to 5% savings at HPCL
offers.terms: HPCL Energie advertises 24 Reward Points/₹150 (4% value at ₹0.25/point) plus 1% fuel surcharge waiver at eligible HPCL outlets, LPG and HP Pay App. Accelerated fuel reward capped at 1,000 points/statement; surcharge waiver capped at ₹100/statement. Confirm exact RuPay variant's schedule of benefits.

offers.title: Domestic airport lounge access
offers.terms: Four complimentary domestic airport lounge visits/year (one per quarter), subject to ₹20,000 spend in the preceding calendar quarter and participating lounge rules. Confirm variant-specific eligibility.

offers.title: 5% cashback on 10 partner merchants
offers.terms: 5% cashback on Amazon, BookMyShow, Cult.fit, Flipkart, Myntra, Sony LIV, Swiggy, Tata CLiQ, Uber and Zomato; capped at 1,000 CashPoints per cycle. 1% on other eligible spends, also capped at 1,000 CashPoints per cycle. Fuel, EMI, wallet and rent are among excluded categories. Statement cashback redemption requires at least 500 points and is capped at 3,000 points per calendar month.

offers.title: ₹1,000 voucher or one domestic lounge access
offers.terms: On eligible spends of ₹1,00,000 or more in a calendar quarter, choose a ₹1,000 brand voucher or one domestic airport lounge access, subject to current milestone terms. This is a choice, not both benefits.

offers.title: 10% cashback on eligible Swiggy app spends
offers.terms: 10% cashback on eligible Swiggy Food Delivery, Instamart and Dineout transactions; capped at ₹1,500 per billing cycle. Swiggy Money Wallet, Liquor, Minis and other excluded categories do not qualify.

offers.title: 5% cashback on eligible online shopping
offers.terms: 5% cashback on eligible online shopping categories/merchants as defined in HDFC terms; capped at ₹1,500 per billing cycle. Category/MCC eligibility applies; not every online transaction qualifies.

offers.title: 1% cashback on other eligible spends
offers.terms: 1% cashback on other eligible spends, capped at ₹500 per billing cycle. Fuel, rent, jewellery, government spends, gift cards, EMI and wallet transactions are among exclusions.

offers.title: Cleartrip instant discounts
offers.terms: Limited-period offer in HDFC terms: 20% instant discount on Cleartrip hotel bookings and 6.35% instant discount on flight bookings. Apply coupon CTSWHDFC; confirm active validity and checkout eligibility before booking.

offers.title: 2% cashback on eligible UPI scan-and-pay
offers.terms: Kiwi Neon earns 2% cashback on eligible scan-and-pay transactions through Kiwi. Online UPI payments earn 0.5%. Kiwis are the reward currency; 1 Kiwi = ₹0.25. Monthly cashback cap is generally 1% of the linked credit limit; eligible MCC exclusions apply.

offers.title: Up to 5% milestone cashback
offers.terms: Neon milestone rewards: 3% at ₹50,000 eligible annual Kiwi spends, 4% at ₹1,00,000 and 5% at ₹1,50,000. Milestone reward is calculated net of cashback already earned under the membership for that year; milestone rewards are over and above monthly cashback cap, subject to full policy.

offers.title: Three complimentary airport lounge visits/year
offers.terms: Kiwi Neon annual membership includes three lounge visits per year, linked to the ₹50,000, ₹1,00,000 and ₹1,50,000 spend milestones (one at each milestone), subject to lounge availability and programme rules.

offers.title: Neon annual membership fee
offers.terms: Kiwi Neon annual membership fee is ₹999 plus applicable taxes. Membership runs for one year from joining and is renewable; check your in-app membership status and renewal date.

notice: Issuer-published card benefits and selected promotions checked on 22 Nov 2026. Ongoing benefits remain subject to card variant, exclusions, transaction category and caps. Limited-period promotions require successful validation at checkout. Source links are provided on each entry.
